findings.text: The baseline arm is proven red only by ImportError: baseline-gate.log shows both tests failing with ImportError: cannot import name '_historical_comparison' from benchmarks.playable_shape_inverse_receipt, because the base scratch tree at 0dfce2a0d carries the new test file but not the function it imports. The done-when asked the test to 'fail on the pre-repair figures or receipt', but the base arm never reaches an assertion, so it does not itself demonstrate that the check refuses the recorded discrimination defect; the discriminating assertions are shown green at head and never shown red against a wrong receipt.

The panel titles are figure-independent in ordering: _shape_titles always writes the arm error on the 'inverse NN mm' line first and the control error on the 'all prescribed NN mm' line second, so on all-prescribed-negative-control.png the drawn shape is the all-prescribed terminal state (81.00 mm / 66.68 mm) while the first numeric line under the title reads the other arm's error ('inverse 18.99 mm' / 'inverse 79.68 mm'). A reader scanning top-down can attach the wrong error to the polygon; naming the drawn subject first would remove the ambiguity.

The all-prescribed terminal states are drawn and titled 'unconverged', but the receipt carries no terminal_residual field, so the figure shows the converged flag and not the residual the done-when's painter rules ask a non-converged state to show (terminal_residual and converged flag). The residual is available for the direction-reversal control (negative_control.receipt.arms[i].terminal_residual) but not for the historical all-prescribed solves, which would need a re-solve to record it.
